Read through the following elements of the Chronic Care Model:

1. Delivery system design – structuring a multidisciplinary health care team with defined roles to care for the patient

2. Clinical information systems – organizing patient and population data to facilitate effective care.

3. Decision-support - embedding evidenced based guidelines into daily practice

4. Self-management support – emphasizing the patient’s central role in managing their health and organizing resources to provide support for self-management.
